cases.rationale: The exact preserved bytes occur inside a complete sentence.
Quotation punctuation outside the exact bytes permits a boundary.
Repeated disjoint occurrences preserve separate offsets and one lineage.
Case folding cannot manufacture an exact occurrence.
Changed punctuation inside the exact value is a different byte string.
An alphanumeric prefix prevents a whole-value boundary.
An immediately adjacent word character after the whole value prevents a boundary.
A prefix of the preserved bytes is insufficient.
Printed escape syntax is not decoded into an occurrence.
Availability of a token does not bind it to this field requirement.
Lexical equality also appears in denial; this witness cannot establish fulfillment or coverage.
The complete status value is retained exactly.
Case-sensitive status values are not normalized.
Unicode connector punctuation is not a permitted word boundary.
ACTIVE inside another word is not an occurrence.
Paired punctuation around the exact status supplies boundaries.
Numeric punctuation and units inside a value are exact bytes.
A numerically similar representation is not byte equality.
Two independently bound values can be recognized in one field.
The scanner must not reinterpret a denied mention as semantic coverage.
Identical eligible bytes from two preserved occurrences cannot choose lineage.
A foreign occurrence is retained diagnostically without making the unique eligible occurrence ambiguous.
Binding both requirements still cannot choose between identical eligible lineages.
An explicit requirement intersection authorizes this exact occurrence for the field.
No binding cannot borrow the available value.
An occurrence with no requirement association is observable but never eligible.
A shorter complete word and a longer value overlap; longest-match guessing is prohibited.
Disjoint unique evidence remains visible while any unresolved overlap blocks the complete field.
Slashes and digits within the assigned exact value are preserved.
A path lookalike differing in case cannot supply exact evidence.
The conservative pinned classifier does not treat a plus symbol as a lexical boundary.
A symbol is not silently treated as separating punctuation by this prototype boundary policy.
Offsets are UTF-8 bytes, not scalar counts.
Canonical equivalence cannot replace original exact bytes.
A decomposed value matches when its exact original spelling is bound.
An adjacent combining mark prevents a boundary after the shorter bytes.
CJK punctuation supplies boundaries and UTF-8 byte offsets remain exact.
No language-specific word segmentation is invented inside adjacent CJK letters.
Unicode spacing delimiters are recognized by the pinned classifier.
A Unicode format character is not a lexical boundary.
Invisible formatting inside a value prevents exact byte equality.
Compatibility folding cannot create an exact match.
Existing prose permits LF/CR/tab; delimiters remain explicit.
Invalid prose controls reject the field before recognition.
C1 controls cannot serve as separators.
Empty input is observable absence, not a positive occurrence.
An empty source value cannot match every position.
Invalid source-value controls reject instead of being stripped.
Occurrence identity must be nonzero.
Conflicting values cannot share an occurrence ID.
Invalid field binding identity rejects before matching.
Duplicate binding IDs reject rather than being silently deduplicated.
Duplicate occurrence associations reject rather than changing eligibility.
